title: HaloBlock: Faster and Better Decoding for Diffusion Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.17948v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) have attracted increasing research attention due to their bidirectional attention and arbitrary order decoding. However, there are two issues in dLLMs inference: the decoding difficulty is dominated by the tokens on the right side of the block, and the block-wise decoding inherently suffers from boundary contextual discontinuity. To tackle these limitations, we propose HaloBlock, a difficulty-aware adaptive halo mechanism for dLLM inference. We first leverage bidirectional cumulative entropy to characterize block decoding difficulty. Then, based on the bidirectional decoding difficulty, we adaptively allocate bidirectional halo regions on both sides of each block to mitigate boundary contextual discontinuity. The difficulty-aware design of HaloBlock smooths cross-block context propagation and lowers decoding difficulty for hard tokens, yielding better generation quality and faster convergence. Ev

translated_title: HaloBlock：面向扩散大语言模型的更快更优解码
translated_abstract: 扩散大语言模型因其双向注意力和任意顺序解码而受到越来越多的研究关注。然而，dLLM 推理中存在两个问题：解码难度由块右侧的 token 主导，且分块解码固有地存在边界上下文不连续的问题。为解决这些局限性，我们提出了 HaloBlock，一种面向 dLLM 推理的难度感知自适应光环机制。我们首先利用双向累积熵来刻画块解码难度。然后，基于双向解码难度，我们在每个块的两侧自适应地分配双向光环区域，以缓解边界上下文不连续问题。HaloBlock 的难度感知设计平滑了跨块上下文传播，降低了困难 token 的解码难度，从而带来更好的生成质量和更快的收敛速度。
tldr: 提出 HaloBlock——一种难度感知的自适应光环机制，利用双向累积熵刻画块解码难度，并在每个块两侧自适应分配双向光环区域以缓解边界上下文不连续问题，从而实现更快收敛和更优的生成质量。
en_tdlr: HaloBlock is a difficulty-aware adaptive halo mechanism that leverages bidirectional cumulative entropy to characterize block decoding difficulty and adaptively allocates halo regions on both sides of each block, mitigating boundary contextual discontinuity for faster convergence and better generation quality in diffusion LLMs.
